evidence.source: Academia Sinica, Institute of History and Philology Museum
evidence.text: The museum describes oracle-bone 年 as 禾 above 人, interpreted as grain carried by a person, and cites the Shang divination pair “我受年 / 我不其受年” in a harvest question. It supports an early harvest sense and pictorial interpretation, but does not establish 人 as a phonetic component.
evidence.kind: institutional paleographic account with transcribed inscription
evidence.title: 我受年──甲骨文「年」的故事

evidence.source: Academia Sinica, Center for Digital Cultures / Chinese Character Database
evidence.field: 字形演變；基本義與構形說明
evidence.text: The entry says 年’s original meaning is crop harvest; oracle-bone and bronze forms have 禾 above 人 and depict a person carrying grain. It reports the small-seal lower 人 as having been misformed into 千. This is a source’s graphic-history account, not an independently verified sequence of dated images in this research.
evidence.title: 漢字「年」：字形演變

evidence.field: 武丁時期甲骨例與「年」的意義
evidence.text: The article attributes an early 年 occurrence to an oracle bone from King Wu Ding’s reign and quotes “其受年？十一月”; it interprets 年 as harvest and proposes extension from one successful grain cycle to a year. This supports that institution’s proposed semantic link, while the article gives no absolute date for the cited bone in the inspected passage.
evidence.title: 媒体关注｜春节的历史渊源

evidence.field: 青銅銘文與古典文獻用例
evidence.text: The article gives Western Zhou bronze inscription examples using 年 in “万年永用/永宝,” and quotes “丰年” from the Book of Odes. These examples show later year/long-duration and harvest-abundance uses, but do not by themselves establish the full chronology from Shang harvest use to each modern sense.
evidence.kind: museum explanatory article citing inscriptions and classical text
evidence.title: 媒体关注｜春节的历史渊源

evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Taiwan, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: A01194-002 異體字：秊;研訂說明
evidence.text: The entry treats 秊 as a variant of 年 and reports traditional dictionary descriptions: Shuowen analyzes it as 禾 with 千 as phonetic; later accounts say 秊/年 followed this analysis and 年 became established through clerical change. This documents the historical lexicographic account, not proof that the earliest oracle-bone lower element was phonetic.
evidence.kind: government dictionary entry with cited historical lexicographic accounts
evidence.title: [A01194-002] 秊 (年) - 教育部《異體字字典》

search_audit.query: 年 字形 甲骨文 金文 小篆 人 禾 说文 收年 博物馆
search_audit.outcome: Inspected museum, character-database, national museum, and Ministry of Education variant-dictionary pages. Evidence supports the early harvest interpretation, competing traditional sound analysis, and some later uses.

search_audit.query: 年 oracle bone inscription harvest 人 禾 paleography Academia Sinica glyph evolution
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the museum and character-evolution pages. The latter reports a lower-element change from 人 to 千 in small seal; the project page gives general context but not additional 年-specific formation evidence.

search_audit.query: 年 Baxter Sagart *C.nˤi[ŋ] phonetic 秊 秂
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the Ministry of Education variant entry; search results surfaced a secondary phonetic-component account, but no external primary phonological or phonetic-series evidence adequate to resolve whether early 人 was phonetic. No component sound array is warranted.

search_audit.query: 年 glyph Wikimedia Commons oracle bone bronze 年 file
search_audit.outcome: Inspected an oracle-bone tracing description and the 年 clerical page; the Shang-bronze file page failed to fetch. A generic inscription tracing lacks a 年-specific identification, so it was not selected.

search_audit.query: Xiaoxuetang 年 字形演變 CC0 1.0 年 glyph
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the Xiaoxuetang query page and Commons descriptions identifying specific Xiaoxuetang records and CC0 reuse. Selected the 年 oracle and seal redraws as candidates; the query page itself did not expose the individual result records in readable text.

gaps: The evidence supports an early Shang harvest use, but a complete dated pathway from harvest to annual period, calendar year, New Year, and age is not established here. The National Museum proposes the grain-cycle-to-year extension; it does not date each semantic step.

Whether 人 had a phonetic role in the earliest graph remains disputed. Pictorial accounts interpret a person carrying grain; traditional Shuowen-derived accounts analyze 秊 as 禾 plus phonetic 千, and another secondary account proposes 人 as phonetic. No adequate primary phonological comparison or early phonetic-series evidence was inspected to decide this.

The lower-element change into 千 is reported by the Sinica character database and historic lexicographic sources, but the proposed corruption sequence was not independently tested against a dated run of glyph images. The Shuowen analysis should be treated as a historical account, not automatic confirmation of original formation.

The supplied local 年 readings and Baxter–Sagart row were not externally verified in this run. The record does not provide component readings for a verified phonetic comparison; no component sound array or ancient sound relationship is asserted.

The Commons Shang-bronze candidate page returned a cache-miss fetch failure. The generic inscription tracing is not identified as showing 年. Chardb.iis.sinica.edu.tw is linked evidence only; its all-rights-reserved image material was not selected. No exact-material permission review justified a local text extract.

items.period: Shang dynasty, oracle-bone script (approximate period label; specific Xiaoxuetang source entry 42.F100)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw labeled as Shang oracle-script 年; the linked source identifies a Xiaoxuetang form record.
items.alt: Modern drawn oracle-script form of 年, with a grain-like upper element above a human-shaped lower element.
items.selection_reason: Shows the early form discussed by the museum and database, with page-level attribution to a specific Xiaoxuetang record and an explicit reuse notice.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 for the sourced Xiaoxuetang glyph image; Commons page also states public-domain status for its modern vector representation. Modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 年 in the Shuowen seal-script style, a useful comparison for the later 千-shaped lower element.
items.alt: Modern seal-script drawing of 年 with a grain-like upper element and a lower element represented in the small-seal tradition.
items.selection_reason: Pairs with the oracle-form candidate to illustrate the database’s reported lower-element change while keeping the seal form identified as a later dictionary tradition.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 for the sourced Xiaoxuetang glyph image; Commons page also states public-domain status for its modern vector representation. Modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.

limitations.text: Both selected glyphs are modern vector redrawings of historical script forms; neither is a photograph of an inscribed Shang object. The oracle candidate’s page gives source-record attribution, but the individual Xiaoxuetang record was not inspected directly in readable form.
